description: SKUEL dependency upgrade policy — see app/docs/decisions/ADR-067-dependency-upgrade-policy.md. PR-only, no auto-merge; verify every bump locally (./dev quality + ./dev test-integration) before merge. CI runs unit + integration tests (testcontainer Neo4j) on py/cypher changes as a backstop.

packageRules.description: Group routine minor/patch bumps into one reviewable PR.
Major bumps get their own PR — they may need an ADR / migration.
INTENTIONAL PINS (ADR-067 § Pins) — neo4j driver must match the server/APOC line (ADR-044); deepgram 5.x+ is a breaking rewrite. Bump only via a deliberate migration, never a routine PR.
Group routine JS minor/patch bumps into one reviewable PR, mirroring pep621.
Major JS bumps get their own PR — same reasoning as pep621 majors.
